newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar, Claas to form combine venture.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar, Claas to form combine venture.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc said Wednesday it would form a North American joint venture company with Germany's Claas KGaA to market and eventually build combine harvesters.
The joint venture company, Caterpillar Claas America LLC, will mark the first time in decades that Caterpillar has a combine on the North American market, a Caterpillar spokeswoman said.
The two companies had previously announced plans for joint ventures in North America and Europe. On Wednesday the companies said they had received regulatory approval for the North American venture.
Caterpillar Claas America will market several models of Claas's Lexion line, which will be adapted for North American farming and sold under the Caterpillar trademark.
The company will begin taking orders this fall and ship to farmers in mid-1998, the spokeswoman said.
